countries.title_en: Wages and technology demand cushion the energy shock
countries.title_zh: 工资与科技需求缓冲能源冲击
countries.read_en: IMF lowered its 2026 growth forecast by 0.1 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 0.6%; it projects 0.7% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 1.25%, 0.25 points above three months earlier.
countries.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版下调0.1个百分点至0.6%，预计2027年为0.7%。2026-09政策利率为1.25%，高于三个月前0.25个百分点。

driver: Energy imports reduce purchasing power when prices rise faster than household income. The Bank of Japan sees wage gains and fiscal measures cushioning that pressure.
能源价格涨幅超过家庭收入时，进口能源会削弱购买力。日本央行认为工资增长与财政措施有助于缓冲压力。
transmission: A stronger yen improves unhedged dollar translation but can reduce overseas earnings in yen.
日元升值改善未对冲的美元换算收益，但可能压低海外利润的日元计价。
upside: If energy costs ease while wage gains hold, real incomes and household spending could improve; broader demand would support domestic-facing earnings.
若能源成本下降且工资增长持续，实际收入与家庭支出可能改善，更广泛的需求将支持内需型企业利润。
downside: If energy and import costs stay high, they could absorb wage gains and constrain consumption even with strong technology demand.
若能源与进口成本持续偏高，可能抵消工资增长并限制消费，即使科技需求仍强。
watch: Real wages, household spending, energy import costs and the next Bank of Japan outlook.
实际工资、家庭支出、能源进口成本与下一份日本央行展望。

title: Wages and technology demand cushion the energy shock
工资与科技需求缓冲能源冲击
read: The Bank of Japan expects higher energy costs to weigh on activity in fiscal 2026. Wage gains, government support and AI demand provide offsets; easing energy pressure and stronger income-to-spending transmission underpin its later pickup.
日本央行预计能源成本上升拖累2026财年经济。工资增长、政府支持与AI需求提供缓冲；能源压力缓解、收入更有效地转化为支出，构成后续增长改善的基础。
driver: Energy imports reduce purchasing power when prices rise faster than household income. The Bank of Japan sees wage gains and fiscal measures cushioning that pressure.
能源价格涨幅超过家庭收入时，进口能源会削弱购买力。日本央行认为工资增长与财政措施有助于缓冲压力。
upside: If energy costs ease while wage gains hold, real incomes and household spending could improve; broader demand would support domestic-facing earnings.
若能源成本下降且工资增长持续，实际收入与家庭支出可能改善，更广泛的需求将支持内需型企业利润。
downside: If energy and import costs stay high, they could absorb wage gains and constrain consumption even with strong technology demand.
若能源与进口成本持续偏高，可能抵消工资增长并限制消费，即使科技需求仍强。
watch: Real wages, household spending, energy import costs and the next Bank of Japan outlook.
实际工资、家庭支出、能源进口成本与下一份日本央行展望。

countries.title_zh: 出口强劲，政策利率上升
countries.read_en: IMF raised its 2026 growth forecast by 0.7 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 2.6%; it projects 2.5% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 3.00%, 0.50 points above three months earlier.
countries.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版上调0.7个百分点至2.6%，预计2027年为2.5%。2026-09政策利率为3.00%，高于三个月前0.50个百分点。

driver: Exports and investment support activity in the central bank’s assessment. Higher rates can act on housing and financing-sensitive spending through a different channel.
央行研判认为出口与投资支撑经济。较高利率则可能通过另一渠道影响住房及对融资敏感的支出。
transmission: Export earnings, the won and domestic financing conditions connect the economy to equities.
出口利润、韩元与国内融资条件将经济变化传导至股市。
upside: If export strength continues and consumption broadens without renewed inflation, growth could spread beyond the external sector.
若出口保持强势，消费扩张且未重新推高通胀，增长有望扩散至对外部门之外。
downside: If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.
若通胀持续，进一步加息传导至借贷成本，家庭与对融资敏感的企业可能面临更大压力。
watch: Exports, consumption, housing and household credit, and subsequent Bank of Korea decisions.
出口、消费、住房与家庭信贷，以及韩国央行后续决策。

title: Export strength meets higher rates
出口强劲，政策利率上升
read: The Bank of Korea describes support from exports, investment and recovering consumption. Inflation and housing-related credit pressures keep further rate increases in view.
韩国央行指出出口、投资与消费复苏支持经济。通胀与住房相关信贷压力，使进一步加息仍在考虑范围内。
driver: Exports and investment support activity in the central bank’s assessment. Higher rates can act on housing and financing-sensitive spending through a different channel.
央行研判认为出口与投资支撑经济。较高利率则可能通过另一渠道影响住房及对融资敏感的支出。
upside: If export strength continues and consumption broadens without renewed inflation, growth could spread beyond the external sector.
若出口保持强势，消费扩张且未重新推高通胀，增长有望扩散至对外部门之外。
downside: If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.
若通胀持续，进一步加息传导至借贷成本，家庭与对融资敏感的企业可能面临更大压力。
watch: Exports, consumption, housing and household credit, and subsequent Bank of Korea decisions.
出口、消费、住房与家庭信贷，以及韩国央行后续决策。

countries.title_en: Exceptional growth is forecast to cool
countries.read_en: DGBAS projects real GDP growth of 11.05% in 2026 and 6.04% in 2027.

driver: Technology exports and capacity investment are central to the published growth outlook.
科技出口与产能投资是已发布增长展望的核心。
transmission: Strong technology demand can support export income while energy and currency costs affect margins.
强劲科技需求支持出口收入，能源与汇率成本则影响利润率。
upside: If technology investment broadens and export demand persists, growth could retain support beyond the leading firms.
若科技投资扩散且出口需求持续，增长支撑可能延伸至龙头企业之外。
downside: If technology spending slows or energy costs rise, concentrated export exposure could amplify the impact.
若科技支出放缓或能源成本上升，集中的出口敞口可能放大影响。
watch: Export orders, capital spending and the next GDP release.
出口订单、资本支出与下一次GDP发布。

countries.title_en: Faster growth projected as inflation rises
countries.title_zh: 增长预计加快，通胀同时上升
countries.read_en: IMF lowered its FY2026 growth forecast by 0.1 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 6.4%; it projects 6.7% for FY2027. Inflation was 4.44% year over year in 2026-07.
countries.read_zh: IMF将FY2026年增长预测较2026-04版下调0.1个百分点至6.4%，预计FY2027年为6.7%。2026-07通胀同比为4.44%。

driver: Domestic demand supports the growth outlook; imported energy can change the inflation trade-off.
内需支持增长前景，进口能源则可能改变通胀的权衡。
transmission: Oil costs and the rupee affect import prices, while financing conditions influence domestic investment.
油价与卢比影响进口价格，融资条件则影响国内投资。
upside: If inflation eases without a demand slowdown, domestic investment could gain breathing room.
若通胀回落而需求未放缓，国内投资将获得更多空间。
downside: If oil and import costs rise, inflation pressure could constrain support for growth.
若油价与进口成本上升，通胀压力可能限制对增长的支持。
watch: Inflation, investment activity and the rupee.
通胀、投资活动与卢比。

countries.title_en: Earlier rate rises are still working through spending
countries.title_zh: 此前加息仍在传导至支出
countries.read_en: IMF lowered its 2026 growth forecast by 0.1 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 1.9%; it projects 1.7% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 4.60%, 0.25 points above three months earlier.
countries.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版下调0.1个百分点至1.9%，预计2027年为1.7%。2026-09政策利率为4.60%，高于三个月前0.25个百分点。

driver: Rate increases can reduce household spending capacity and investment demand. The RBA expects slowing demand to help reduce inflation.
加息可能压低家庭支出能力与投资需求。澳大利亚央行预计需求放缓将有助于通胀回落。
transmission: Commodity income supports the external sector; interest rates shape household spending capacity.
大宗商品收入支持对外部门，利率影响家庭支出能力。
upside: If inflation falls with only a modest slowdown in employment and spending, households could regain purchasing power without a sharp contraction.
若通胀回落，同时就业与支出仅温和放缓，家庭购买力可能恢复，而无需经历剧烈收缩。
downside: If higher borrowing costs weaken spending more than expected while energy inflation persists, growth could slow before households receive price relief.
若借贷成本上升对支出的打击超出预期，而能源通胀持续，经济可能在家庭获得价格缓解之前先行放缓。
watch: Household spending, unemployment, housing activity and inflation’s response to earlier rate increases.
家庭支出、失业率、住房活动与通胀对先前加息的反应。

title: Earlier rate rises are still working through spending
此前加息仍在传导至支出
read: The RBA expects earlier interest-rate increases to slow spending, with their full effect still ahead. Its August outlook places inflation’s return to the midpoint of its target range in early 2028 and anticipates a gradual rise in unemployment.
澳大利亚央行预计此前加息将减缓支出，其完整影响尚未显现。8月展望预计通胀于2028年初回到目标区间中点，失业率则逐步上升。
driver: Rate increases can reduce household spending capacity and investment demand. The RBA expects slowing demand to help reduce inflation.
加息可能压低家庭支出能力与投资需求。澳大利亚央行预计需求放缓将有助于通胀回落。
upside: If inflation falls with only a modest slowdown in employment and spending, households could regain purchasing power without a sharp contraction.
若通胀回落，同时就业与支出仅温和放缓，家庭购买力可能恢复，而无需经历剧烈收缩。
downside: If higher borrowing costs weaken spending more than expected while energy inflation persists, growth could slow before households receive price relief.
若借贷成本上升对支出的打击超出预期，而能源通胀持续，经济可能在家庭获得价格缓解之前先行放缓。
watch: Household spending, unemployment, housing activity and inflation’s response to earlier rate increases.
家庭支出、失业率、住房活动与通胀对先前加息的反应。

countries.title_en: A gradual pickup, with policy rates steady
countries.title_zh: 预计逐步加快，政策利率稳定
countries.read_en: IMF raised its 2026 growth forecast by 0.2 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 1.0%; it projects 1.3% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 3.75%, unchanged over three months.
countries.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版上调0.2个百分点至1.0%，预计2027年为1.3%。2026-09政策利率为3.75%，较三个月前不变。

driver: Services inflation and wage growth matter for the pace of monetary easing.
服务业通胀与工资增长影响货币宽松的节奏。
transmission: Lower financing costs can support domestic demand; sterling also changes overseas earnings translation.
融资成本下降可支持内需，英镑也会改变海外利润的换算。
upside: If services inflation cools while spending holds, a gradual recovery could gain support.
若服务业通胀降温且支出保持稳定，渐进复苏可能获得支持。
downside: If inflation stays persistent, prolonged borrowing costs could restrain an already modest growth path.
若通胀持续，高企的借贷成本可能抑制本已温和的增长路径。
watch: Services prices, wages and household spending.
服务价格、工资与家庭支出。

countries.title_en: A firmer outlook still depends on energy relief
countries.title_zh: 前景改善仍取决于能源压力缓解
countries.read_en: IMF lowered its 2026 growth forecast by 0.2 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 0.9%; it projects 1.2% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 2.50%, 0.25 points above three months earlier.
countries.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版下调0.2个百分点至0.9%，预计2027年为1.2%。2026-09政策利率为2.50%，高于三个月前0.25个百分点。

theme: Energy, real incomes and public investment
能源、实际收入与公共投资
driver: Lower energy inflation can restore household purchasing power, while infrastructure and defence spending support investment. Those are assumptions behind the ECB’s improving growth path.
能源通胀下降可能恢复家庭购买力，基建与国防支出则支持投资。这些构成欧洲央行增长路径改善的前提。
transmission: Import costs affect real incomes; bank lending conditions transmit policy into investment and consumption.
进口成本影响实际收入，银行信贷条件将政策传导至投资与消费。
upside: If energy pressure eases as assumed and public investment reaches activity, domestic demand could carry more of the growth pickup.
若能源压力按预期缓解，公共投资转化为实际活动，内需可能为增长改善提供更多动力。
downside: If the energy shock persists, real-income gains could be delayed while higher input costs pressure margins and slow the projected pickup.
若能源冲击持续，实际收入改善可能推迟，投入成本上升则可能压缩利润率、拖慢预期中的增长改善。
watch: Energy prices, real household incomes, investment spending and bank lending.
能源价格、家庭实际收入、投资支出与银行信贷。

title: A firmer outlook still depends on energy relief
前景改善仍取决于能源压力缓解
read: The ECB’s September assessment finds the economy more resilient than expected. Its baseline relies on the energy shock fading, real incomes recovering and infrastructure and defence spending supporting demand; persistent export competitiveness problems remain a constraint.
欧洲央行9月研判认为经济韧性强于预期。其基准情景依赖能源冲击消退、实际收入恢复，以及基建与国防支出支持需求；出口竞争力问题仍构成限制。
theme: Energy, real incomes and public investment
能源、实际收入与公共投资
driver: Lower energy inflation can restore household purchasing power, while infrastructure and defence spending support investment. Those are assumptions behind the ECB’s improving growth path.
能源通胀下降可能恢复家庭购买力，基建与国防支出则支持投资。这些构成欧洲央行增长路径改善的前提。
upside: If energy pressure eases as assumed and public investment reaches activity, domestic demand could carry more of the growth pickup.
若能源压力按预期缓解，公共投资转化为实际活动，内需可能为增长改善提供更多动力。
downside: If the energy shock persists, real-income gains could be delayed while higher input costs pressure margins and slow the projected pickup.
若能源冲击持续，实际收入改善可能推迟，投入成本上升则可能压缩利润率、拖慢预期中的增长改善。
watch: Energy prices, real household incomes, investment spending and bank lending.
能源价格、家庭实际收入、投资支出与银行信贷。

countries.scope_note_en: Equities use STOXX Europe 600, which includes markets outside the Euro Area.
countries.scope_note_zh: 股票采用STOXX欧洲600指数，覆盖范围包含欧元区以外市场。

若科技支出放缓或能源成本上升，集中的出口敞口可能放大影响。
watch: Export orders, capital spending and the next GDP release.
出口订单、资本支出与下一次GDP发布。

display_countries.title_en: Faster growth projected as inflation rises
display_countries.title_zh: 增长预计加快，通胀同时上升
display_countries.read_en: IMF lowered its FY2026 growth forecast by 0.1 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 6.4%; it projects 6.7% for FY2027. Inflation was 4.44% year over year in 2026-07.
display_countries.read_zh: IMF将FY2026年增长预测较2026-04版下调0.1个百分点至6.4%，预计FY2027年为6.7%。2026-07通胀同比为4.44%。

driver: Domestic demand supports the growth outlook; imported energy can change the inflation trade-off.
内需支持增长前景，进口能源则可能改变通胀的权衡。
transmission: Oil costs and the rupee affect import prices, while financing conditions influence domestic investment.
油价与卢比影响进口价格，融资条件则影响国内投资。
upside: If inflation eases without a demand slowdown, domestic investment could gain breathing room.
若通胀回落而需求未放缓，国内投资将获得更多空间。
downside: If oil and import costs rise, inflation pressure could constrain support for growth.
若油价与进口成本上升，通胀压力可能限制对增长的支持。
watch: Inflation, investment activity and the rupee.
通胀、投资活动与卢比。

display_countries.title_en: Earlier rate rises are still working through spending
display_countries.title_zh: 此前加息仍在传导至支出
display_countries.read_en: IMF lowered its 2026 growth forecast by 0.1 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 1.9%; it projects 1.7% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 4.60%, 0.25 points above three months earlier.
display_countries.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版下调0.1个百分点至1.9%，预计2027年为1.7%。2026-09政策利率为4.60%，高于三个月前0.25个百分点。

driver: Rate increases can reduce household spending capacity and investment demand. The RBA expects slowing demand to help reduce inflation.
加息可能压低家庭支出能力与投资需求。澳大利亚央行预计需求放缓将有助于通胀回落。
transmission: Commodity income supports the external sector; interest rates shape household spending capacity.
大宗商品收入支持对外部门，利率影响家庭支出能力。
upside: If inflation falls with only a modest slowdown in employment and spending, households could regain purchasing power without a sharp contraction.
若通胀回落，同时就业与支出仅温和放缓，家庭购买力可能恢复，而无需经历剧烈收缩。
downside: If higher borrowing costs weaken spending more than expected while energy inflation persists, growth could slow before households receive price relief.
若借贷成本上升对支出的打击超出预期，而能源通胀持续，经济可能在家庭获得价格缓解之前先行放缓。
watch: Household spending, unemployment, housing activity and inflation’s response to earlier rate increases.
家庭支出、失业率、住房活动与通胀对先前加息的反应。

title: Earlier rate rises are still working through spending
此前加息仍在传导至支出
read: The RBA expects earlier interest-rate increases to slow spending, with their full effect still ahead. Its August outlook places inflation’s return to the midpoint of its target range in early 2028 and anticipates a gradual rise in unemployment.
澳大利亚央行预计此前加息将减缓支出，其完整影响尚未显现。8月展望预计通胀于2028年初回到目标区间中点，失业率则逐步上升。
driver: Rate increases can reduce household spending capacity and investment demand. The RBA expects slowing demand to help reduce inflation.
加息可能压低家庭支出能力与投资需求。澳大利亚央行预计需求放缓将有助于通胀回落。
upside: If inflation falls with only a modest slowdown in employment and spending, households could regain purchasing power without a sharp contraction.
若通胀回落，同时就业与支出仅温和放缓，家庭购买力可能恢复，而无需经历剧烈收缩。
downside: If higher borrowing costs weaken spending more than expected while energy inflation persists, growth could slow before households receive price relief.
若借贷成本上升对支出的打击超出预期，而能源通胀持续，经济可能在家庭获得价格缓解之前先行放缓。
watch: Household spending, unemployment, housing activity and inflation’s response to earlier rate increases.
家庭支出、失业率、住房活动与通胀对先前加息的反应。

display_countries.title_en: A gradual pickup, with policy rates steady
display_countries.title_zh: 预计逐步加快，政策利率稳定
display_countries.read_en: IMF raised its 2026 growth forecast by 0.2 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 1.0%; it projects 1.3% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 3.75%, unchanged over three months.
display_countries.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版上调0.2个百分点至1.0%，预计2027年为1.3%。2026-09政策利率为3.75%，较三个月前不变。

driver: Services inflation and wage growth matter for the pace of monetary easing.
服务业通胀与工资增长影响货币宽松的节奏。
transmission: Lower financing costs can support domestic demand; sterling also changes overseas earnings translation.
融资成本下降可支持内需，英镑也会改变海外利润的换算。
upside: If services inflation cools while spending holds, a gradual recovery could gain support.
若服务业通胀降温且支出保持稳定，渐进复苏可能获得支持。
downside: If inflation stays persistent, prolonged borrowing costs could restrain an already modest growth path.
若通胀持续，高企的借贷成本可能抑制本已温和的增长路径。
watch: Services prices, wages and household spending.
服务价格、工资与家庭支出。

display_countries.title_en: A firmer outlook still depends on energy relief
display_countries.title_zh: 前景改善仍取决于能源压力缓解
display_countries.read_en: IMF lowered its 2026 growth forecast by 0.2 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 0.9%; it projects 1.2% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 2.50%, 0.25 points above three months earlier.
display_countries.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版下调0.2个百分点至0.9%，预计2027年为1.2%。2026-09政策利率为2.50%，高于三个月前0.25个百分点。

theme: Energy, real incomes and public investment
能源、实际收入与公共投资
driver: Lower energy inflation can restore household purchasing power, while infrastructure and defence spending support investment. Those are assumptions behind the ECB’s improving growth path.
能源通胀下降可能恢复家庭购买力，基建与国防支出则支持投资。这些构成欧洲央行增长路径改善的前提。
transmission: Import costs affect real incomes; bank lending conditions transmit policy into investment and consumption.
进口成本影响实际收入，银行信贷条件将政策传导至投资与消费。
upside: If energy pressure eases as assumed and public investment reaches activity, domestic demand could carry more of the growth pickup.
若能源压力按预期缓解，公共投资转化为实际活动，内需可能为增长改善提供更多动力。
downside: If the energy shock persists, real-income gains could be delayed while higher input costs pressure margins and slow the projected pickup.
若能源冲击持续，实际收入改善可能推迟，投入成本上升则可能压缩利润率、拖慢预期中的增长改善。
watch: Energy prices, real household incomes, investment spending and bank lending.
能源价格、家庭实际收入、投资支出与银行信贷。

title: A firmer outlook still depends on energy relief
前景改善仍取决于能源压力缓解
read: The ECB’s September assessment finds the economy more resilient than expected. Its baseline relies on the energy shock fading, real incomes recovering and infrastructure and defence spending supporting demand; persistent export competitiveness problems remain a constraint.
欧洲央行9月研判认为经济韧性强于预期。其基准情景依赖能源冲击消退、实际收入恢复，以及基建与国防支出支持需求；出口竞争力问题仍构成限制。
theme: Energy, real incomes and public investment
能源、实际收入与公共投资
driver: Lower energy inflation can restore household purchasing power, while infrastructure and defence spending support investment. Those are assumptions behind the ECB’s improving growth path.
能源通胀下降可能恢复家庭购买力，基建与国防支出则支持投资。这些构成欧洲央行增长路径改善的前提。
upside: If energy pressure eases as assumed and public investment reaches activity, domestic demand could carry more of the growth pickup.
若能源压力按预期缓解，公共投资转化为实际活动，内需可能为增长改善提供更多动力。
downside: If the energy shock persists, real-income gains could be delayed while higher input costs pressure margins and slow the projected pickup.
若能源冲击持续，实际收入改善可能推迟，投入成本上升则可能压缩利润率、拖慢预期中的增长改善。
watch: Energy prices, real household incomes, investment spending and bank lending.
能源价格、家庭实际收入、投资支出与银行信贷。

display_countries.scope_note_en: Equities use STOXX Europe 600, which includes markets outside the Euro Area.
display_countries.scope_note_zh: 股票采用STOXX欧洲600指数，覆盖范围包含欧元区以外市场。

world_brief.title_en: Taiwan’s growth is forecast to cool sharply in 2027.
world_brief.title_zh: 台湾2027年增长预计将明显放缓。
world_brief.read_en: DGBAS projects 11.05% growth in 2026, moderating to 6.04% in 2027.

focus.title_zh: 出口强劲，政策利率上升
focus.read_en: IMF raised its 2026 growth forecast by 0.7 percentage points from its 2026-04 edition, to 2.6%; it projects 2.5% for 2027. The 2026-09 policy rate was 3.00%, 0.50 points above three months earlier.
focus.read_zh: IMF将2026年增长预测较2026-04版上调0.7个百分点至2.6%，预计2027年为2.5%。2026-09政策利率为3.00%，高于三个月前0.50个百分点。

driver: Exports and investment support activity in the central bank’s assessment. Higher rates can act on housing and financing-sensitive spending through a different channel.
央行研判认为出口与投资支撑经济。较高利率则可能通过另一渠道影响住房及对融资敏感的支出。
transmission: Export earnings, the won and domestic financing conditions connect the economy to equities.
出口利润、韩元与国内融资条件将经济变化传导至股市。
upside: If export strength continues and consumption broadens without renewed inflation, growth could spread beyond the external sector.
若出口保持强势，消费扩张且未重新推高通胀，增长有望扩散至对外部门之外。
downside: If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.
若通胀持续，进一步加息传导至借贷成本，家庭与对融资敏感的企业可能面临更大压力。
watch: Exports, consumption, housing and household credit, and subsequent Bank of Korea decisions.
出口、消费、住房与家庭信贷，以及韩国央行后续决策。

title: Export strength meets higher rates
出口强劲，政策利率上升
read: The Bank of Korea describes support from exports, investment and recovering consumption. Inflation and housing-related credit pressures keep further rate increases in view.
韩国央行指出出口、投资与消费复苏支持经济。通胀与住房相关信贷压力，使进一步加息仍在考虑范围内。
driver: Exports and investment support activity in the central bank’s assessment. Higher rates can act on housing and financing-sensitive spending through a different channel.
央行研判认为出口与投资支撑经济。较高利率则可能通过另一渠道影响住房及对融资敏感的支出。
upside: If export strength continues and consumption broadens without renewed inflation, growth could spread beyond the external sector.
若出口保持强势，消费扩张且未重新推高通胀，增长有望扩散至对外部门之外。
downside: If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.
若通胀持续，进一步加息传导至借贷成本，家庭与对融资敏感的企业可能面临更大压力。
watch: Exports, consumption, housing and household credit, and subsequent Bank of Korea decisions.
出口、消费、住房与家庭信贷，以及韩国央行后续决策。
